# 3D Compute Manager Week 2: Introducing Blueprints for Infrastructure Planning


### Introducing Blueprints - plan your infrastructure before you build it


[Strong Compute](https://substack.com/@strongcompute)


Jul 17, 2025


## **What's New This Week**


This week we're rolling out Blueprints, a fundamental shift in how you approach GPU infrastructure planning. Instead of reacting to immediate needs, you can now design your ideal infrastructure layout and let Strong Compute automatically fulfill it.


### **Blueprints: Intention Meets Reality**


**The Problem:** Most infrastructure gets built reactively. Someone needs compute, provisions it quickly, and you end up with a sprawling mess of unplanned resources across multiple providers with no clear strategy.


**The Solution:** Blueprints let you design your infrastructure intentionally. Create blueprint regions, clusters, and nodes that represent what you want to exist. The system then automatically finds and provisions resources that match your specifications.


**How It Works:**


-


Design blueprint infrastructure (displayed as blue wireframes above your real resources)


-


System automatically discovers and provisions matching resources


-


One-to-one mapping between planned and actual infrastructure


-


Clear visual separation between intention (top) and reality (bottom)


### **Visual Infrastructure Planning**


Blueprint regions appear as blue wireframe overlays above your actual infrastructure. This spatial separation makes the relationship between planning and execution immediately clear.


When you create a blueprint cluster with specific GPU requirements, the system goes out and finds real hardware that matches those specifications. Each blueprint node corresponds to an actual server running in a data center somewhere.


The visual layout shows you exactly how your intentions map to reality - no spreadsheets, no abstract resource counts, just direct visual correspondence.


### **Automatic Resource Fulfillment**


**Blueprint-to-Reality Mapping:** Every blueprint element gets a unique ID that tracks through to actual provisioned resources. This means you can see exactly which real compute corresponds to which planned infrastructure.


**Automatic Provisioning:** When you create blueprints, the system automatically starts finding and provisioning matching resources across our provider network. No manual procurement, no vendor negotiations, no complex deployment scripts.


**Manual Override Available:** For specialized requirements, you can manually provision resources and embed the blueprint ID to map them back to your planning layer.


### **Discrepancy Detection**


**Over/Under Provisioning Visibility:** The visual interface makes it immediately obvious when reality doesn't match intention. Too many resources? You'll see extra infrastructure below your blueprints. Not enough? You'll see unfulfilled blueprint elements.


**Organized Infrastructure:** Blueprints ensure all your real infrastructure exists for a reason. No more mystery compute that someone spun up "temporarily" six months ago and forgot about.


**Capacity Planning:** See exactly how much additional infrastructure you need to fulfill your complete blueprint design.


## **Technical Implementation**


**Unique Blueprint IDs:** Every blueprint element generates a tracking ID that follows through to actual resources, enabling automatic mapping and monitoring.


**Multi-Provider Discovery:** The system searches across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle, Lambda Labs, and our partner network to find resources matching your specifications.


**Real-Time Sync:** Blueprint fulfillment happens continuously - as resources become available, they automatically map to your outstanding blueprint requirements.


## **User Experience**


**Plan-First Workflow:** Design your ideal infrastructure layout before provisioning anything. See potential costs, resource allocation, and deployment strategy before committing.


**Visual Validation:** Immediately see whether your actual infrastructure matches your intended design. No more guessing about resource allocation or wondering why you have compute in unexpected places.


**Iterative Refinement:** Adjust blueprints in real-time and watch the system adapt resource allocation to match your updated plans.

## **Try Blueprints Now**


Blueprint functionality is live in the sandbox environment at


[cp.strongcompute.ai](https://cp.strongcompute.ai/)


**Experiment freely:** Create complex blueprint designs and see how the system would fulfill them in practice.


**Learn the workflow:** Understand how intention-driven infrastructure planning changes your approach to resource management.


**Test scenarios:** Design blueprints for different workload types and see optimal resource allocation strategies.


## **Why This Matters**


Most infrastructure problems stem from poor planning, not technical limitations. When you can visualize your intended infrastructure before building it, you make better decisions about resource allocation, provider selection, and capacity planning.


Blueprints transform infrastructure management from reactive firefighting to proactive design. You decide what you want, then let the system figure out how to build it efficiently.


This is infrastructure management as it should be - intentional, visual, and automated.
